decisions.reason: The camera sits close to the firm's core optical and space-navigation know-how, which the firm's own R&D and university cooperation strengthen, so it can interpret early results and refine the product.

A modular navigation camera extends the firm's established offer and fits its push toward flexible, compact sensors for smaller satellites, giving it strong absorptive capacity to improve the product.

The situational awareness suite builds on the firm's existing sensor and imaging expertise, and its research networks and EU projects supply the related knowledge needed to develop this growing application.
The miniaturized LiDAR matches the firm's docking and optoelectronic heritage and its miniaturization strategy, though its thinner website presence suggests a somewhat less mature market position.
